name: 92350 · Loma Linda, CA
findings: ZIP 92350 (Loma Linda) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (86%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 10 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92350 (Loma Linda) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92350 (Loma Linda) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.0 times the typical level).
